heard: Campus outcasts blew up a lab and built NASA's Premier Space Center. In 1936, Frank Malina teamed up with rocketeers Jack Parsons and Edward Forman. Their motor tests caused explosions, earning the group the campus nickname Suicide Squad. After blasting through a wall, the squad was banished to a dry riverbed called Arroyo Seco. Working outdoors, they built take-off rockets for propeller aircraft, proposing the name Jet Propulsion Laboratory in 1943. In 1958, JPL launched America's first satellite, Explorer 1, before transferring to the newly created NASA. That former riverbed camp went on to manage Voyager 1, the first human craft in interstellar space. America's space program began with a campus explosion.
